newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks gain 1.33 pct in active market.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks gain 1.33 pct in active market.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed higher after most blue chips gained in active trading, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all share price index rose 44.44 points or 1.33 percent at 3,368.09. Turnover was 273.3 million taka. Of 116 traded issues, 69 rose, 46 lost and 1 flat.
"Investors are gaining back confidence with tension between the DSE authorities and the regulators easing. Buying orders are pouring in again," said broker Moshtaque Ahmed.
Beximco Pharma was the volume leader with 104,550 scrips traded at 15.44 taka up at 477.04. Chittagong Cement lost 857.28 to 16,288.41 on profit taking. --Dhaka Newsroom 880-2-506363
